'''Victor Michael Panaretos''' (born 1982) is a Greek [[Mathematical Statistician|mathematical statistician]]. He is currently Professor and Director at the Institute of Mathematics of the [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne]] (EPFL), where he holds the chair of [[Mathematical Statistics]].

Panaretos works at the interface of [[nonparametric statistics]], [[random process]]es, and [[stochastic geometry]]. He is known for contributions to the [[functional data analysis]] of random functions, operators, and measures.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2018-08-03|title=Statistical inference for random functions and measures|url=https://erc.europa.eu/projects-figures/stories/statistical-inference-random-functions-and-measures|access-date=2021-02-26|website=ERC: European Research Council|language=en}}</ref> He has published widely in statistical theory and methods as well as in applied probability, and is the author of two books.<ref>{{Cite book|last=Panaretos|first=Victor M.|url=https://www.springer.com/gp/book/9783319283395|title=Statistics for Mathematicians: A Rigorous First Course|date=2016|publisher=Birkhäuser Basel|isbn=978-3-319-28339-5|series=Compact Textbooks in Mathematics|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|last1=Panaretos|first1=Victor M.|url=https://www.springer.com/gp/book/9783030384371|title=An Invitation to Statistics in Wasserstein Space|last2=Zemel|first2=Yoav|date=2020|publisher=Springer International Publishing|isbn=978-3-030-38437-1|series=SpringerBriefs in Probability and Mathematical Statistics|language=en}}</ref>

==Education==
Panaretos received his PhD from the [[University of California, Berkeley]] in 2007, advised by [[David R. Brillinger]].<ref name=mathgene/><ref name=arxiv>{{cite journal |last=Panaretos|first=Victor M.|author-link= |arxiv=1201.2047 |title=A Conversation with David R. Brillinger  |date=2011 |doi=10.1214/10-STS324|journal=Statistical Science|volume=26|issue=3|pages=440–469|s2cid=62563408 }}</ref> His doctoral thesis was awarded the [[Erich Leo Lehmann|Erich Lehmann]] award.<ref>{{Cite web|title=The Erich Lehmann Fund in Statistics {{!}} Department of Statistics|url=https://statistics.berkeley.edu/giving/erich-lehmann-fund-statistics|access-date=2021-02-26|website=statistics.berkeley.edu}}</ref>

==Career and research==
After graduation Panaretos took up a faculty position at [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne]] (EPFL), becoming the youngest person ever to be appointed to a chair at the institution.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Victor M. Panaretos|url=https://www.weforum.org/people/victor-m-panaretos/|access-date=2021-02-26|website=World Economic Forum|language=en}}</ref> He is an elected member<ref>{{Cite web|title=ISI Elected Members - ISI|url=https://www.isi-web.org/about-isi/who-is-isi/members/indivual/isi-elected-members|access-date=2021-02-26|website=isi-web.org}}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> of the [[International Statistical Institute]] and a [[Fellow]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics {{!}} Congratulations to the 2019 IMS Fellows!|url=https://imstat.org/2019/05/15/congratulations-to-the-2019-ims-fellows/|access-date=2021-02-26|language=en}}</ref> of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]]. He was a recipient of a [[European Research Council]] (ERC) Starting Grant Award in 2010,<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Rossi|first=Lara|date=2011-12-01|title=Excellence doesn't depend on age!|url=https://actu.epfl.ch/news/excellence-doesn-t-depend-on-age/|language=en}}</ref> and the 2019 [[Bernoulli Society for Mathematical Statistics and Probability|Bernoulli Society]] Forum Lecturer.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Papageorgiou|first=Nik|date=2018-03-26|title=Victor Panaretos to deliver 2019 Bernoulli Society Forum Lectures|url=https://actu.epfl.ch/news/victor-panaretos-to-deliver-2019-bernoulli-society/|language=en}}</ref>

An active member of the [[Bernoulli Society for Mathematical Statistics and Probability|Bernoulli Society]] and its parent organization, the [[International Statistical Institute]], Panaretos has served the probability and statistics community from several posts, notably as the editor of Bernoulli News,<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bernoulli News|url=http://www.bernoulli-society.org/publications/bernoulli-news|access-date=2021-02-26|website=bernoulli-society.org}}</ref> a member of the ISI Council,<ref>{{Cite web|title=Council - ISI|url=https://www.isi-web.org/about-isi/who-is-isi/council|access-date=2021-02-26|website=isi-web.org}}</ref> and as [[President-Elect]] of the Bernoulli Society.<ref>{{Cite web|title=New President-Elect of the Bernoulli Society - ISI|url=https://www.isi-web.org/news-featured/20423-new-president-elect-of-the-bernoulli-society|access-date=2021-02-26|website=isi-web.org}}</ref>

Panaretos has served on the [[editorial board]]s of  the ''[[Annals of Statistics]]'', the ''[[The Annals of Applied Statistics|Annals of Applied Statistics]]'', ''[[Biometrika]]'', the ''[[Electronic Journal of Statistics]]'', and the ''[[Journal of the American Statistical Association]]''.
